controls.implementation: TARGET: M1 noun/verb CLI with readonly diag/status views. CURRENT: legacy `peerhub` default plus side-by-side 11-leaf `peerhub-m1`; default cutover is a separate IMPLEMENTING gate.
controls.rationale: Do not force Engram-like verb hierarchy. Do not confuse target conformance with current public-entrypoint maturity.

controls.implementation: Public help must be side-effect free and generated/drift-tested from the command contract.
Publish a PeerHub semantic exit map; preserve existing numeric behavior until a compatibility-safe migration.
controls.rationale: Breaking automation for numeric symmetry has low value.
controls.revisit_trigger: When a major-version CLI break is already justified.

controls.implementation: Declarative config/catalog/policy with explicit precedence; runtime/model facts remain structured. Absent/null/empty/unknown semantics follow the common schema rule for new/changed contracts.
Core authoritative SQLite/records separated from extension projections, logs, evidence and catalogs.
JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts; versioned Core/Extension schemas and transactional migration.
Lifecycle class: Core=Peer/Stream/Record/Offset; M1 built-in modules; M2+ extensions. Boundary role is separately ADAPTER/PROVIDER where applicable.
controls.rationale: Dependency direction is the architecture foundation.

controls.implementation: M1 Session Bridge/Observation/Diag are statically assembled MODULEs; M2.0 introduces Generic Extension Host. A2A/remote-runtime translators use ADAPTER boundary role.
controls.rationale: This resolves the apparent M1-extension vs M2-extension-runtime contradiction.

controls.implementation: TARGET: Observation owns quota/rate/runtime facts; Diag is readonly display. CURRENT M1 module can render observations/resource pools, while side-by-side `peerhub-m1 diag health` is stream-only; quota display parity is a public-cutover gate.
Record/evidence/source identity, release evidence and gate freshness are explicit.

Fencing/idempotency/readonly diag/public-port-only extension writes/fail-closed storage. External/downloaded artifacts keep source/version/digest or equivalent integrity provenance appropriate to risk.
109 legacy commands classified; historical lesson/directive/task/governance names do not force old domains to return.
Candidate-bound gates, live/package gates and evidence freshness policy.
Machine SSOT plus generated/views and validator drift checks.

exceptions.rationale: Peer/Stream/Record/Offset remain the only Core concepts through all required and optional roadmap work.
M1 first-party modules are not dynamically installable extensions; the generic Extension Host starts at M2.0.
Do not force Engram-style lifecycle verb hierarchy onto communication resources; it would reduce clarity.
